mapper.select: SELECT post_id AS postId, title, content, writer, view_count AS viewCount, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM notice ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT post_id AS postId, title, content, writer, view_count AS viewCount, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM notice WHERE post_id = #{postId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notice (title, content, writer, view_count, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, #{writer}, 0, NOW(), NOW())
